title: Shei Vinitras
summary: Shei Vinitras replaces his decoy with a raid encounter that punishes deaths.
overview: Shei Vinitras replaces his decoy with a raid encounter that punishes deaths.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Expect the apparent Shei to give way to the real boss.
Assign a plan for Death Touch and keep the raid stable; player and pet deaths can generate more enemies.
Pick up the summoned adds quickly so one death does not become a chain of losses.
